entries.title: Psalms 95:1
segments: ¶O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

words.text: : let us make a joyful noise

entries.title: Psalms 95:2
segments: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms. {come...: Heb. prevent his face}

entries.title: Psalms 95:3
segments: For the LORD [is] a great God, and a great King above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 95:4
segments: In his hand [are] the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills [is] his also. {In...: Heb. In whose} {the strength...: or, the heights of the hills are his}

words.text: [is] his also. {In...: Heb. In whose} {the strength...: or, the heights of the hills are his}

entries.title: Psalms 95:5
segments: The sea [is] his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry [land]. {The sea...: Heb. Whose the sea is}

words.text: [land]. {The sea...: Heb. Whose the sea is}

entries.title: Psalms 95:6
segments: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
segments: ¶For he [is] our God; and we [are] the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
segments: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, [and] as [in] the day of temptation in the wilderness: {provocation: Heb. contention}

entries.title: Psalms 95:9
segments: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
segments: Forty years long was I grieved with [this] generation, and said, It [is] a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
segments: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest. {that...: Heb. if they enter into my rest}

words.text: . {that...: Heb. if they enter into my rest}
